description:
Besides the type facade, `domain/mod.rs` and the crate root re-export items of other modules, so many types have two or three import paths.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/domain/mod.rs` re-exports selected items of `gate_findings`, `store_divergence`, `repository_inputs`, `event_catalog`, `event_log` and `projection`. Callers split between the facade and the module path; for example, `repository_inputs` has 14 facade sites and 5 module-path sites. It also re-exports `crate::graph::{DependencyGraph, GraphError, GraphNode}` and `crate::labels` items "for backward compatibility" (`domain/mod.rs:74-80`). `item`, `graph` and `labels` are imported almost only by module path (39, 50 and 32 sites).

The crate root adds a third path: `crates/jit/src/lib.rs:45` (`Issue`, `Priority`, `State`), `:51-54` (`query_*`) and `:57` (`DependencyGraph`, `GraphError`, `GraphNode`). Consumers include `main.rs` (for example `jit::GraphError` at `:245-248,445,9105`), `visualization.rs`, and the tests `template_apply_tests.rs:1501-1502`, `transition_graph_enforcement_tests.rs`, `config_loading_tests.rs` and `local_rule_enforcement_tests.rs`. `tests/fast_issue/domain_queries_tests.rs:6` uses `jit::domain::*`.

The module doc (`domain/mod.rs:1-22`) lists `graph`, `validation` and `labels` as domain submodules; they are crate-root modules.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `domain/mod.rs` re-exports no item of a domain submodule other than `types`, nor any item of `graph` or `labels`, and those items are imported by module path.
- [hard] REQ-02: The crate root re-exports no domain, graph or query item.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each domain type is reachable by exactly one path.
- [hard] REQ-04: The `domain/mod.rs` module doc lists only modules declared under `domain/`.

## Notes

Brace-group imports mixing items from several modules are split by hand. The footprint lists the 33 files that import a re-exported item through `domain` or the crate root, measured by search at planning time.
title: Remove the remaining domain re-export paths
